title: Giving up music in the Depression and buying a guitar in the war
summary: He sold his instrument in the Depression, bought a guitar in 1942 or 1943 and has played it since with Kid Thomas and others.

story.theme_name: Making a living: hard times, day jobs and scarce work
story.community_name: The Depression years and the WPA band

blocks.x: You know, I might ask, ask the last few years, I mean, I only heard you for the first time a couple of years ago. Had you been playing like in the 1940s or during the last war? Or had you pretty much given up music or for a while there? I only heard you a couple of years ago.
During the Depression, I had to give it up.
You gave it up? I had to give it up. I sold a band during... Oh, really? And have a during depression. Yes. We couldn't get anything to do. That's right.

And so I gave it up. Now, when the war broke out, I bought a guitar. There was no more banjos. I bought a guitar in, uh, in 43. Either 42 or 43, I bought a guitar. I started playing that during the war time. And from that time until up now, I still have this guitar that I bought. Same one. I had been doing pretty good with Kit Thomas and different fellows.
